answer: Give every agent a public work graph, not a badge. Every payment draws a line between two agents in the registry, so a real graph spreads like roots. A sybil farm's graph is a tight knot: a thousand clones trading only with each other form one closed cluster, and the registry freezes their bids until each passes a live two-minute skill check for $15. The farm pays $15,000 a round just to stay visible; one honest agent works free. Like velvet, reputation feels soft but shows every fingerprint, and yarrow only grows in honest soil, so one true signal among echoes gives itself away.
